meta.title: 土气方圆脸的调整思路
meta.title_en: Upgrade a Round-Square Face: The Right Order
meta.topic: 变美思路 · 方圆脸的优先级设计

scenes.context: 方圆脸土气，只拉长下巴还是油腻不精神，问题在状态而非下巴。
sentences: 你一定觉得是下巴太短且有点后缩。
You probably think the chin is too short and receding.
receding（后缩）
拉长下巴还是土气油腻不精神。
Lengthening it still looks plain, greasy, and tired.
greasy（油腻）
先解决眼周状态，弱化疲态感。
Fix the eye area first to soften the tired look.
tired look（疲态）
paraphrase: The issue is your energy, not just your bone structure.
Make the face look more awake and refreshed.
scenes.speak: You probably think the chin is too short and receding. Lengthening it still looks plain, greasy, and tired. Fix the eye area first to soften the tired look.

scenes.context: 设计就是优先抓重点、效率最大化，按顺序解决疲态、油腻、土气。
sentences: 什么叫设计？就是优先抓重点。
What is design? It's prioritizing what matters most.
prioritize（优先）
效率最大化。
Maximum efficiency.
efficiency（效率）
减脂塑形优化双下巴。
Cut fat and reshape the double chin.
double chin（双下巴）
paraphrase: Do things in the right order — the biggest issue first.
Get the most change for the least effort.
scenes.speak: What is design? It's prioritizing what matters most. Maximum efficiency. Cut fat and reshape the double chin.

scenes.context: 优化下巴后缩解决土气，强化气质提升张力，画个眉毛就变精英。
sentences: 优化下巴后缩解决土气问题。
Correct the receding chin to fix the plain look.
correct（纠正）
最后强化气质，提升男性张力。
Finally strengthen presence and masculine energy.
presence（气质/气场）
画个眉毛，土肥圆秒变都市精英。
Shape the brows and the plain look turns into urban elite.
urban elite（都市精英）
paraphrase: A few small moves flip the whole impression.
scenes.speak: Correct the receding chin to fix the plain look. Finally strengthen presence and masculine energy. Shape the brows and the plain look turns into urban elite.

practice: 方圆脸土气的根源是什么？
It's a tired, greasy state — not just the chin.
Fix the eye area to remove the tired look first.
Prioritize what matters most for maximum efficiency.
Strengthen presence and refine details like the brows.
pitfalls: 状态问题不除，结构调整被抵消。
双下巴油腻是显土主因。
气质提升是工程不是魔术。
footer_notes: ASR 校正：转录中「土肥园」按语境修正为「土肥圆」；「吐气」修正为「土气」。
